# X360 Mobile 0.6.4 — Hotfix 1

This maintenance update fixes game-folder import and unnecessary temporary game copies, and adds a way to silence repeated external-display prompts.

## Fixes

- **Game folders on fresh installations:** fixed a folder-import path that could report “No XEX, ELF, ISO, ZAR or STFS/GOD titles found” even when the selected folder contained supported games. Android can expose different file lists depending on the storage permissions granted; folder import now uses the authorized access method instead of treating an incomplete local listing as an empty folder.
- **Direct ISO/ZAR access:** supported images exposed by Android's file picker can now be read directly when the storage provider supports it. Previously, the absence of a normal filesystem path could trigger an unnecessary full temporary copy even though the image was readable. Providers that only offer streams or partial files may still require the explicit copy option.
- **Repeated TV-mode prompts:** added a persistent option to disable automatic external-display prompts, plus “Don't ask again” in the prompt itself. This gives users a way to stop repeated notices when Android incorrectly reports an external screen. Manual TV-mode and display selection remain available in Settings → Interface → Displays and TV.

## Updating

- Public version **0.6.4**, build **60411108**. Existing installations can update in place and keep their data.
- If a folder failed to import previously, select it again after updating. All-files access remains available through Android's permission screen.
- TV mode and synchronized player profiles remain highly experimental.
- Includes the features and improvements from the [original 0.6.4 release](https://github.com/Ashnar2602/X360-Mobile---OFFICIAL/releases/tag/v0.6.4%2Bf398ad183).
